Romera is the ''shatayan'' of the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]]. She is stately, straight-backed, and has graying hair that she keeps in a thick roll at the nape of her neck. She has charge of all the palace's servants.

== Appearance ==
Mistress Romera is a tall, handsome woman with hazel eyes.{{ref/book|0|24}}

== Activities ==
Romera personally conducts [[Lan Mandragoran]] to the Prince Consort, [[Brys Noramaga]]. She addresses Lan with more courtesy than would be expected from a head servant to an uncrowned king, which Lan believes hints at her personal belief that [[Malkier]] will rise once more.{{ref/book|0|22}}

She later escorts Lady [[Moiraine Damodred]] [[Aes Sedai]] to the Prince after she makes herself known at the palace.{{ref/book|0|24}}
